ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) clusters at distal extremities, creating a low global contrast ratio of approximately 0.12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark pigmentation across central fluke regions; high-contrast white geometric clusters localized exclusively at the far lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 64 degrees; vertical depth from lobe peaks to notch base is approximately 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary containing approximately 14 distinct peaks on the left lobe and 12 on the right; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 5 to 18 pixels relative to a smoothed baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves originating at the median notch and tapering toward the distal tips; the right lobe displays a more pronounced horizontal elongation compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two dense constellations of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters located at the extreme lateral margins, consistent with heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct high-contrast white linear disruptions on the right lobe: one horizontal line (~80 pixels) and two diagonal marks (~40 pixels) positioned in the upper-mid quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified clusters at distal tips; multiple linear white scars on the right fluke lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and splash occlusion at the lower central boundary of the fluke; multiple high-intensity specular highlights from water droplets across the dark ventral surface.
